title_en: Process for preparation of mesotrione and its intermediates
legal_status_note: The Google Patents family table gives this publication, PCT/IB2021/057013, as not_active / Ceased, which is the ordinary end of an international phase rather than a refusal. Taken from the page rather than inferred. The family is not dead: its US member US12497355B2 is listed Active, and ZA2023/01455A is listed unknown.
family_members_note: US12497355B2 (from US 18/019,070) and ZA2023/01455A are in family 80036183 with this publication. Neither is in TARGETS.md. Recorded here so that a later run does not annotate one of them as a separate patent: they are the same disclosure and would be a duplicate, which is the rule row 5 carries against US8309769B2.
abstract_zh: The present disclosure provides a new and improved process for preparation of intermediate compounds and synthesis of mesotrione therefrom. The present disclosure provides an economical, efficient and eco-friendly process for preparation of mesotrione.
ipc_codes_note: Field (51) prints a single classification, C07C 315/06 (2006.01).
assignees_note: Field (71) prints 'RALLIS INDIA LIMITED [IN/IN]', Mumbai, Maharashtra. Typed multinational_corp rather than sme: it is a listed Indian agrochemical company and a Tata Chemicals subsidiary, not a small or medium enterprise. The enum has no plain 'company' value, which is the mistake row 5 made.
inventors_note: Field (72) prints these in WIPO surname-first form as 'PANIRAJ, A.S.', 'KUMAR. D, Suresh' and 'S.V.R, Adithya', all three at Rallis India Limited, Byregowda Industrial Estate, Bangalore, Karnataka (IN). Reordered to natural given-name-first form, which is what WO2000021924A1 did with 'VAN ALMSICK, Andreas'. The printed forms are kept here because these are South Indian names carrying initials rather than a western given-plus-family pair, and a reader checking the page will see the printed order. The stop after KUMAR is printed on the page and is not a transcription slip.

text_provenance.note: All 23 pages are scanned images and the PDF carries no text layer at all, zero characters. Pass V is the only way to read any of this document, prose included, which is the case the V prompt was written for. Two things follow from the front page. It is published with the international search report under Art. 21(3), so the final pages are examiner material and not description, and A0 has a search_report section type for them. And field (43) states the publication is in black and white although the application as filed contained colour or greyscale, so any shading that carried meaning in a structure drawing is already gone from what is being read here; the colour original is on PATENTSCOPE and was not used.
